attributes.name: image loading integrity
attributes.definition: Whether images and icon glyphs on the page render correctly, without broken images, missing icon-font glyphs, or invalid dimensions.

values.definition: All images and icons load and display with valid sizes; none are broken.
One or more images or icon glyphs fail to load or display (broken image, tofu/missing glyph, zero size).
The page contains no images or icon glyphs to evaluate.
